header: Label and value pairs with an optional caveat
lead: For the attributes of one subject, not rows of a data set. It is a description list, so there is no header row to fill in.
caption: The caption names the subject and the conditions the figures apply to
note: For a data set with a source, use Captioned Data Table. To weigh two options against each other, use Comparison Matrix.

rows.title: Minimum rows
rows.text: A single pair reads better as a sentence.

rows.title: Maximum rows
rows.text: Beyond 40 rows, readers start searching instead of reading.

rows.title: The caveat line
rows.text: It sits under both columns and belongs to its pair.

rows.title: Below 480px
rows.text: Side by side, a long label would leave only two words per line.
